name: ARA4011
title: Unsupported style value
summary: A style property has a value the native UI does not support (for example an unknown position or alignment keyword).
html:
A style property has a value the native UI does not support (for example an unknown position or alignment keyword).

#Common causes

  • A CSS keyword the native layout does not implement.

#Fixes

  • Use one of the supported values listed in the message.

  • Code: ARA4011

  • Constant: ui::PROPERTY

  • Reported by: ara-ui
